scope: Opt-in q32 subring-switch RAM prototype; retained owners, requests, input ciphertexts and CKKS evaluation material. Observed timing results are specific to this run. No complete security or universal performance claim.

results.scope: Experimental ring bridge, independent persistent RAM states, same retained requests. Existing TFHE noise/KDM and whole-run failure qualification remain open.

jobs.external_cpu_monitor_scope: All host CPUs, subtracting child process CPU; observations, not proof of isolation.
All host CPUs, subtracting child process CPU; observations, not proof of isolation.

implemented_parameter_selection_screen.scope: Classical generic LWE proxy at effective small-ring dimension. Unbounded samples. Variance-matched discrete-Gaussian proxy for truncated continuous normal. Does not certify RLWE/ring-specific attacks, exact error PMF, cross-scheme circular/KDM security, or complete protocol security.

noise_assessment_reference.scope: Conditional ideal-Gaussian uniform bridge-error bound; input phase budget is separately audited for observed executions.

No change to the timed arithmetic or timed paths. Measured source snapshots and the complete patches are retained.

qualification_limits: Existing lower-noise TFHE public material is not repaired by this prototype.
Generic LWE estimates use a variance-matched noise proxy; ring-specific and exact-sampler security remain open.
Observed input-error audits do not prove upstream noise for all RAM traces.
External CPU samples describe the whole job and do not prove timing isolation.

corrected_validation_attempt.reason: Comparison harness incorrectly required the 256-cell retained fixture to have exactly five requests. It now validates the complete eight-request fixture and uses the first five, matching the retained crossover protocol. All reported measurements come from the corrected fresh run.

final_source_build.note: Rebuilt after the recorded report-metadata and indentation cleanup. Performance observations use the measured binary hashes in provenance.
